theorems.name: Submission.bv_convolution_sub_lintegral_le_of_translate
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F ρ : Rn n → ℝ) (Q : Set (Rn n)) (σ : ℝ) (C : ℝ≥0∞), Integrable F volume → Continuous ρ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) → Function.support ρ ⊆ ball 0 σ → ∫ x, ρ x = 1 → (∀ t : Rn n, ‖t‖ < σ → ∫⁻ x in Q, ‖F (x - t) - F x‖ₑ ≤ C) → ∫⁻ x in Q, ‖convolution ρ F (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x - F x‖ₑ ≤ C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
